title: Escape menu & visibility fixes
content: Esc opens an in-game menu (press again or Resume to close)
Reload UI remounts the 3D view and HUD without leaving the room
Map builder cemetery catalog has more props (barrels, ruins, trees, walls, and the rest of the set)
fixes: Orbiting Wisp is visible to the hunter who cast it
Walking into the shop no longer leaves you stuck with a green silhouette
Void Disc steers with you on the way out instead of locking the first heading

title: Wave Assault pathing & scenery
content: Wave Assault map layout and scenery updated
Wave Assault ladder now tracks team bests, with filters for party size
Shop sells a third saved loadout (unlock the second slot first)
highlights: Wave Assault mobs path around props instead of walking straight through them
Mobs face the way they are walking, then turn to you when they attack or cast
When a prop hides you, an ally, or an enemy, a silhouette shows through — stealthed hunters stay hidden
Wave Assault HUD shows the party's combined score and a list of drafted buffs
fixes: Void Disc keeps moving when you turn back on yourself
balance: Fortified Resolve now cuts the next incoming attack by 50% (DoT ticks no longer consume it)
After a block, the +25% block-chance window lasts 4s (was 2s)

title: Dungeon instances
content: Dungeon is a new PvE style, separate from Wave Assault: walk an authored map, pull packs, and clear a boss
Parties of 1–5 spawn at the entrance; difficulty scales with how many hunters showed up
Required packs sit still until aggro. Each run also picks one optional wing (side pack, hold, or extra boss)
Killing the end boss unlocks the exit. Interact there to complete; a wipe still ends the run
One run chest at the end — rarity rises with how deep you got (packs, optional wing, then boss). Guests skip
Plaza groups lock to Dungeon or Wave Assault separately so they never share a queue
fixes: Map-builder prop catalog keeps only assets that maps actually use

title: Combat polish, rejoin, and stealth
content: Battlegrounds queue 2v2 through 5v5 from the lobby
Skirmish arenas play on Test Arena; maps can be tagged for modes in the builder
If you drop from a live match, rejoin it from the lobby while it is still going
balance: Phantom Rush dashes through a lone target twice when nobody else is in reach
Silence lasts 2s, and the debuff bar matches remaining time
Jump Slam and Dash follow the cursor for shorter hops and rolls (max range unchanged)
Wave Assault spawn counts and caps are lower
Soul Relay also triggers from heals, including shrooms
Divine Beam is a true 3s hold channel
Blooming Path is wider, lingers longer, and grows a bit slower
fixes: Cloak works in Wave Assault; auto-target spells skip invisible hunters
Decoy looks like you to enemies (name, bar, and ring) instead of an ally
Cloak no longer shows your aura, pulse, or ground ring
Bulwark Charge looks smooth for other players — no mid-charge teleport
Groove and other heals no longer heal Wave Assault mobs
Shop: Hide renamed to Body color; ink stays locked until you own an aura
An empty first spell slot is forced onto M1

title: Wave Assault — Infinite Waves
content: Wave Assault now plays on PVE - Infinite Waves: a large painted arena with authored start pads and perimeter rush-in points
The party shares one random start pad each run; retries roll a new pad
Enemies come from the map's spawn directions but appear close to the hunters instead of on the far pads

title: Choose your first build
content: New hunters start with an empty bar — pick a spell for every key at the House (first pick per family is free)
Queue unlocks once all seven keys are slotted; flex slots are essence buys and stay optional
Finish the first kit to earn a tutorial chest (essence for talent points — talents are bought, not gifted)
fixes: All characters have been reset to this first-build slate

title: New F Ultimates & Divine Beam Rework
content: Cyclone Kick: devastating spinning kick dealing massive melee damage in a 2.35m radius
World Tree: summon a persistent magical tree that intelligently heals the lowest-health nearby ally with flying seeds
Phantom Rush: rush rapidly through up to 4 nearby enemies, dealing 100 damage per strike
Ascendant Form: grow to 1.5x scale, gaining 22% damage reduction, +15% melee radius, and a 2.5m damage aura
Dread Aura: surround yourself with a terrifying reactive aura — enemies who begin casting inside are feared away
balance: Divine Beam: reworked Heal Beam with ramping channel healing and cascading overflow to nearby injured allies

title: Five new Q utility spells
content: Purge Pulse: cleanse one debuff from nearby allies and strip one buff from nearby enemies
Rock Wall: raise a temporary stone barrier that blocks movement and projectiles
Hex Anchor: mark an enemy — their next movement ability roots them on arrival
Iron Guard: brief brace with damage reduction and displacement immunity (at a heavy slow)
Spellbreaker: shatter nearby hostile projectiles and bank cast-speed charges for your next hit

title: Five new Space spells
content: Verdant Leap: leap to an ally or dummy — heal both (80), share +20% move, green trail; out-of-range ring like Soul Relay
Bulwark Charge: 6m sprint that resists knockbacks/CC, blocks frontal damage, and shoulders enemies aside, then a 120 shield
Predator Step: brief Cloaked + Predator Rush haste (no dash)
Rebound: wider frontal wind blast + self recoil (Gust-style smoke)
balance: Teleport Slam: larger slam radius, shorter stun; windup starts later in the clip for a snappier preload

title: Blooming Path & new spell wave
content: Blooming Path (E): slow ground vine — stand in the corridor to heal yourself and allies (20 every 0.5s) while it grows and lingers
New kit spells: Soul Mark, Void Disc, Runic Shard, Orbiting Wisp, Astral Chain, Underground Pulse, Slipstream, Soul Relay, Crushing Sigil
E-slot additions: Gravity Well, Prism Lance, Soul Sever, Arc Blade
fixes: Cast bar HUD, status ornaments, and spell VFX/icon polish across the new set

title: Wave Assault (PvE)
content: PvE portal: Wave Assault — cemetery map with escalating zombie waves
Seeking melee fodder, wave HUD, pause / leave mid-run
Solo for now — coop and boss encounters come later

title: Smoke Bomb, ranked LP & combat polish
content: Smoke Bomb (Q): grey smoke at your feet — Weakened (−20% defense) on enemies; stay cloaked while you remain in the cloud
Ice Lance, admin no-cooldowns toggle, emote shop dances
balance: Protection Bubble: more transparent dome; shield cap raised to 300
Fireball projectile hitbox scales with charge size; cast plays slightly faster
Frost Ball CD 7s; Decoy 14s; Counter/Revenge 12s; Gust stays 10s; Bolt damage up; spell unlock costs ×10; starter wallet + 1 talent point
fixes: Spell armory autosaves on equip (Save loadout removed); hotbar updates immediately
Ranked: placement matches removed — league points apply from the first ranked finish
Talent UI: Points shows spendable only; spent/budget sits beside Trees
Hub portals: torus “donuts” removed (interact pads remain)
Assorted VFX/UI fixes

title: Spirit Form, Hand Shield & rewards
content: Hand Shield (RMB): channel a blue disc that shatters enemy projectiles — cancel anytime; blocks through the drop animation
Spirit Form (Space): leave a husk, rush forward with haste; the husk↔spirit link stuns enemies that cross it; recast or wait to snap back
Revenge (Q): red Counter stance — deny the next direct hit, vanish, and blink behind the attacker
Quests, chests, friend codes, and match reward payouts (see recap when activity-scaled)
fixes: Stun cancels in-progress casts (players and practice dummies)
Projectiles that hit walls fizzle with a downward spray
Spore Shrooms, Magma Orbs, Volcano, and Protection Bubble combat + VFX
Friends / party invites stacked in one prompt UI; hub roster and talent stand polish

title: Counter, Poison Dart & combat polish
content: Counter (Q): rooted gold-glow stance — deny the next melee/projectile hit, then +20% damage, +20% move, and 40% resistance for 3s (cuts other casts; cancel anytime)
Poison Dart (RMB): right-hook throw with stacking poison (up to 3) and a poison icon on health bars
Firewall (E/Q/F): lava-crack ground + vertical flame wall that ignites mid-cast (cancel before), draws center→edges, burns with a flame icon on health bars
Barrier: self absorb bubble that charges through the cast
Heal Beam: channelled ally heal line
balance: Critical hits: 5% chance for 1.5× damage or healing
fixes: Ability bar cooldown sweep uses a lighter overlay so it stays readable

title: Hub music, settings & loading
content: Village looping soundtrack on the hub
Updates / patch notes on the home screen and in play (Settings too)
fixes: Settings: master, music, and effects volume (effects ready for future SFX)
Loading gate preloads hub/arena assets before the HUD appears
Shop and PvE portal show only “In development” while locked

title: Talent trees & spell tags
content: WoW-style talent trees at the talent stand (catalog preview; combat wiring later)
Abilities carry spell tags and effect kinds for future talent hooks
fixes: Merchant UI locked for development
